person.title: Design Engineer, web and AI-assisted development
person.summary: Ten-plus years at the intersection of design and engineering: turning design vision into production-ready, responsive web experiences in React and closing the design-to-development gap for creative and enterprise brands. Strong in design systems, rapid prototyping from concept to production, interaction and motion design, typography, and accessibility. An early adopter of agentic AI who architected Claude-powered internal and creative tooling the team came to depend on, cutting delivery timelines by 52%.
